**Handoff written to [HANDOFF.md](HANDOFF.md).**

Root cause is `dep-4471`, which set `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true` at `02:13:41`. Each request then took its own connection from a pool of 20. Window runs `02:14:18Z` to `03:59:27Z`, 530 of 1228 requests failed. Roll back `dep-4471`.

Two things the doc flags. The log is `node-3 of 3`. It ends with 503s still firing, so check live status first.
